questions.prompt: An aircraft flies at 450 mph for 2.5 hours. How far does it travel?
A jacket costs $80. It is discounted 25%, and then 5% sales tax is added to the sale price. What is the final cost?
Crew A can complete an inspection in 6 hours. Crew B can complete it in 3 hours. Working together, how long will it take?
questions.explanation: Rates add: 1/6 + 1/3 = 1/6 + 2/6 = 3/6 = 1/2 job per hour, so 2 hours.

questions.prompt: An airplane burns 12 gallons of fuel per hour and carries 90 gallons. The pilot must land with a 30-minute fuel reserve. How many hours can the plane fly before reaching the reserve?
questions.explanation: Reserve = 0.5 × 12 = 6 gallons. Usable fuel = 84 gallons. 84 ÷ 12 = 7 hours.

questions.prompt: Two jets leave the same base at the same time, flying in opposite directions at 400 mph and 500 mph. After how many hours will they be 2,700 miles apart?
questions.explanation: Moving apart, their speeds add: 900 mph. 2,700 ÷ 900 = 3 hours.
